facts.name: Rocky Face Mountain Recreational Area (park)
facts.what: Alexander County public park on Rocky Face Mountain, southern edge of the Brushy Mountains; former granite quarry (operated ~1922 to early 1940s), opened as a county recreational park in 2012/2013. ~318 acres (some sources 326-330). Contains ~5-6 miles of hiking trails leading to the summit, rock climbing, camping, picnic shelters, playground, community building. On the NC Registry of Natural Heritage Areas.
facts.elevation: summit approx 1795 ft (~547 m); ~600 ft above surrounding terrain
facts.access: Address 3451 Rocky Face Church Rd, Hiddenite NC 28636. Gravel parking lot at quarry/entrance. Open 8am-8pm.

facts.name: Rocky Face Mountain summit
facts.what: Dome-shaped exfoliating granite pluton; maximum elevation ~1795-1800 ft, roughly 600 ft above the surrounding Piedmont. Reached by the park's trail network (Hollow Rock / Vertical Mile route). Summit area offers panoramic views of the Brushy Mountains; on clear days Grandfather Mountain reportedly visible.
facts.access: Reached via Hollow Rock Trail upper loop from main parking; summit is within the ~318-acre public park, well under 3 mi from Rocky Face Church Rd

facts.name: Hollow Rock Trail
facts.what: Main/most popular trail in the park; AllTrails lists ~3.1 mi with ~688 ft elevation gain (other sources ~2.5 mi round trip). Begins with an ascent up stone-cut stairs, then a gravel trail; climbs to the mountain summit. Upper loop passes views of the Brushy Mountains (and possibly Grandfather Mountain).
facts.elevation: 688 ft elevation gain; tops out near 1795 ft summit
facts.access: Trailhead at main park parking area off Rocky Face Church Rd

facts.name: Vertical Mile Challenge (route) / Challenge Trail
facts.what: Marked challenge route: begins on the Grindstone Trail (~0.5 mi easy forested section), turns onto the Challenge Trail at a creek crossing, climbs an exposed granite slab (~30-degree incline, described as nearly vertical, an open granite face climb compared to Stone Mountain State Park but without assist stairs); at the summit the Challenge Trail joins the Hollow Rock Trail (option to add ~2 more miles or return to parking). Descent has switchbacks with views from the top of the sheer cliff face.
facts.elevation: open granite slab climb to ~1795 ft summit
facts.access: From main park trail network/parking via Grindstone Trail; creek crossing partway

facts.name: Summit overlooks and picnic tables (Hollow Rock Trail top)
facts.what: Multiple overlooks on top of the granite dome offer panoramic valley/Brushy Mountain views; picnic tables are placed at the top of the Hollow Rock Trail overlooking the valley
facts.access: Top of Hollow Rock Trail

facts.name: Vertical Mile Challenge Club QR-code signage
facts.what: QR-code signs along the Challenge route for the Vertical Mile Challenge Club, which tracks cumulative vertical miles completed (milestones at 1, 5, 10, 100 vertical miles)
facts.access: Along Challenge Trail route

facts.name: Buzzard Loop Trail
facts.what: Loop trail in the park, approximately 0.8 mile (8/10 mile)
facts.access: Park trail network from main parking

facts.name: Grindstone Trail
facts.what: Trail in the park, approximately 1 mile
facts.access: Park trail network from main parking

facts.name: Prison Camp Trail
facts.what: Moderate trail, approximately 1 mile; winds through an area that historically served as a prison camp in the mid-20th century
facts.access: Park trail network from main parking

facts.name: Paved ADA walking track (quarry loop)
facts.what: Paved ~0.3-mile (one-third mile) accessible walking track/loop located in the former quarry area near the parking lot/entrance, beside the quarry cliff walls
facts.access: At/near main entrance and gravel parking lot off Rocky Face Church Rd

facts.name: Quarry cliff face (rock climbing crag)
facts.what: Sheer man-made granite cliff (former quarry, ~1922-early 1940s) with vertical walls rising more than 80 feet (some sources ~100 ft); ~58-60+ established bolted sport/top-rope climbing routes, beginner to expert. Forms the backdrop of the parking area. Daily climbing/rappelling permit required from the Park Office.
facts.access: Adjacent to main parking lot and entrance; permit from Park Office

facts.name: Wildlife observation decks (two)
facts.what: Two wildlife observation decks are featured park amenities, associated with the wetland/wetland restoration area
facts.access: Within park near wetlands/boardwalk area

facts.name: Wetlands with boardwalks / wetland restoration area
facts.what: Constructed wetlands area with boardwalks and a wetland restoration area; part of the park's outdoor classroom/education features
facts.access: Within park, accessed from lower/trail areas

facts.name: Outdoor amphitheater
facts.what: Outdoor amphitheater within the park, used for events/programming
facts.access: Within park grounds

facts.name: Picnic shelter(s), Park Office, restrooms
facts.what: Built amenities: park office, restrooms/bathrooms, picnic shelters, and a multipurpose/community building available for rent, near the entrance/quarry area
facts.access: At main entrance off Rocky Face Church Rd

facts.name: Children's adventure playground (natural playground)
facts.what: Natural/adventure children's playground featuring a zip cord and large slide
facts.access: Within park near main facilities

facts.name: Primitive campsites (two)
facts.what: Two primitive campsites available within the park
facts.access: Accessed via park trails

facts.name: Stone-cut stairs (Hollow Rock Trail start)
facts.what: Built stone-cut staircase at the start of the Hollow Rock Trail ascent before the trail transitions to gravel
facts.access: Start of Hollow Rock Trail from parking

facts.name: Numbered trail-marker signage system
facts.what: The park uses a numbered trail map system with corresponding numbers posted on trees along the trails so hikers can locate their position
facts.access: Throughout park trail network

facts.name: Outdoor classroom
facts.what: Outdoor classroom/education feature within the park (associated with wetlands and natural heritage area programming)
facts.access: Within park grounds
